memoryTip: Exhausts every option — complete, thorough, nothing left out.
correctPassage: An exhaustive review of the literature found no support for the claim.
wrongPassages: The committee issued an exhaustive statement that addressed only the first of several open questions.
After an exhaustive glance at the abstract, she claimed to have mastered the entire study.
Critics dismissed the audit as exhaustive because it skipped half the departments under review.

memoryTip: Hetero = different — a mixed, diverse group.
correctPassage: The sample was deliberately heterogeneous, including rural and urban schools.
wrongPassages: Researchers described the cohort as heterogeneous even though every participant shared the same age, income, and education level.
The alloy was labeled heterogeneous despite consisting of a single pure metal throughout.
Editors praised the anthology’s heterogeneous voice after noticing that every essay repeated the same argument in the same style.

memoryTip: Like an imperative sentence (command) — must-do, essential.
correctPassage: With the storm approaching, it was imperative that residents evacuate promptly.
wrongPassages: Selecting a typeface for the cover letter felt imperative to the success of the clinical trial.
The board treated the optional icebreaker as imperative and canceled the safety briefing instead.
Because nothing of consequence hinged on the outcome, finishing the form became imperative overnight.

definition: a subtle difference in meaning or expression
memoryTip: A fine shade of meaning — subtle, not black-and-white.
correctPassage: The translation preserved every nuance of the original poem’s tone.
wrongPassages: The campaign’s nuance was a single all-caps slogan designed to be read from a highway billboard.
He reduced the policy debate to a binary choice and called that nuance enough for voters.
Her report captured every nuance by replacing detailed analysis with a yes-or-no checklist.

memoryTip: Causes controversy — people argue about it.
correctPassage: The museum’s controversial exhibit drew both praise and protests.
wrongPassages: The controversial ordinance passed unanimously and prompted no public comment whatsoever.
Parents and inspectors alike endorsed the upgrade, so the media labeled it the year’s most controversial reform.
Analysts called the quiet consensus vote controversial after an entirely uneventful session with no dissent.
